hypothesis: In direction_1h markets during the final 60-300 seconds, the favorite token quoted 0.50-0.60 at the executable ask is systematically underpriced, because attention and quoting competition concentrate on the 5-minute markets and hourly books go stale near resolution.

discovery_evidence.method: Retrospective borg_book_snaps calibration: one snapshot per resolved market (first snapshot with tte 60-300s), favorite defined as the side with the higher best ask, executable ask entry, crypto taker fee 0.07*p*(1-p) per share at 1x and 2x.
discovery_evidence.window: 2026-07-17 through 2026-07-18 capture days (1h snapshot capture begins at tte<=300s only)
discovery_evidence.negative_control: Identical cell on direction_5m: n=1698 markets, win rate 0.527, -0.0339 per share at 1x — the effect is absent where quoting attention is concentrated.
known_weaknesses: Only two capture days; day-clustered n=2.
Pooled effect is ~1.7 sigma against the priced probability; not significant alone.
Per-asset split (btc +0.069, eth +0.052, xrp +0.221, sol -0.131 over ask 0.50-0.70) is treated as noise per the standing subgroup lesson; no asset is excluded.
The 0.50-0.60 band and 60-300s window were selected after inspecting the calibration table; this is post-selection and is why the arm starts a fresh forward clock.

frozen_mechanics.favorite_definition: side with the strictly higher best ask; equal asks skip
frozen_mechanics.execution: single taker buy of the favorite at the displayed ask, latency_1s execution model, 20% displayed-touch participation, TARGET_STAKE_USD stake, once per market, hold to terminal resolution

registered_prediction: If the mechanism is real, forward mean net P&L per entered market is positive at 2x costs (discovery point estimate ~ +$1.7 per $10 stake). If hourly books are efficient, the arm converges to approximately -1x fees per market.

evaluation.multiple_testing: Correct across the full H1-H52 research family and every discarded variant, not merely this arm.
evaluation.early_kill: If mean net_pnl_2x per entered market is below zero at 150 independent markets, stop the arm and record the negative result.
evaluation.overlap_rule: Markets also entered by any other 1h arm must be reported jointly; do not sum overlapping arms as independent profit.
evaluation.promotion: No live path. Passing the mechanical read only triggers a separate implementation and risk review.
evaluation.null_outcome: Measured edge may be approximately zero; no parameter or inverse signal may be selected from the discovery cohort.
